description.en: Add a website record for the team. Pass a name; optional URL and type (undefined|shop). Slug is generated automatically.
description.de: Fügt einen Website-Eintrag für das Team hinzu. Name angeben; optional URL und Typ (undefined|shop). Der Slug wird automatisch erzeugt.

warp.bot: Add a website with team + name. Optional url and type. type=shop requires url and marks this site as the post-checkout storefront return URL (one shop per team; brandless records only). Omit type or pass type=undefined for a normal website/portfolio record. Do not pass slug — it is generated from the name. Optionally pass contactId, metricsSource, metricsResource, and monthlyReport=true to opt into the 1st-of-month report job (does not send now). If enabling monthlyReport returns channel_not_configured for cloudflare, call settings-integration-open with integration=cloudflare, then retry. Use site-provision when the site should be live on a Warp brand.

en.question: Does this publish a live sites.joai.ai app?
en.answer: No. It stores a website record you can report on. Use site-provision for a live brand site.

en.question: What does type shop do?
en.answer: After payment, the JoAi thank-you page redirects buyers to that site URL.

de.question: Veröffentlicht dies eine Live-App auf sites.joai.ai?
de.answer: Nein. Es speichert einen Website-Eintrag für Reporting. Für eine Live-Markenseite site-provision verwenden.

de.question: Wofür ist Typ shop?
de.answer: Nach der Zahlung leitet die JoAi-Danke-Seite Käufer zu dieser Website-URL zurück.
